headline_item.title_zh: 英伟达组建国家安全与出口管制监督委员会
headline_item.title_en: Nvidia's board establishes a National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee to oversee national security policies, export control compliance, and more (Nvidia Newsroom)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 英伟达董事会设立专项委员会，旨在强化全球贸易风险管理及出口合规的董事会层级监管
headline_item.event_summary_en: NVIDIA's Board of Directors has established the National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee, chaired by Suzanne Nora Johnson, with Stephen C. Neal and John O. Dabiri as members. This committee will provide direct board-level oversight for the company's National Security Team and Global Trade Compliance Team to manage global trade risks.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达(NVIDIA)董事会；委员会主席Suzanne Nora Johnson在企业治理架构层面：设立国家安全与出口管制监督委员会，将国家安全团队与贸易合规团队纳入委员会直接监管体系
【起因与机理】应对先进计算技术对国家安全影响的复杂挑战，确保在全球贸易监管环境下实现合规与业务平衡
【调查与监管诉求】核心动因：应对先进算力技术对国家安全带来的地缘政治合规挑战。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：强化供应链防御韧性，降低因合规性缺失带来的全球化业务中断风险。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] NVIDIA Board of Directors; Suzanne Nora Johnson (Chair) (Corporate governance): Established a new committee to oversee the National Security Team and Global Trade Compliance Team
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To address national security challenges posed by advanced AI silicon and navigate tightening global trade regulations
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Core driver: Addressing geopolitical compliance risks surrounding advanced AI silicon.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Outlook: Strengthening supply chain resilience to minimize operational disruptions under strict trade regulations.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此举标志着英伟达将地缘政治合规性从行政运营提升至最高决策维度，意在通过董事会直接介入，减少因出口政策突变导致的技术脱钩风险。这不仅是对美国商务部出口管制政策的制度化响应，也是为了在应对持续收紧的监管审查时，能够通过更专业、更具透明度的治理架构获取政府侧的信任红利。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This move signals the elevation of geopolitical compliance from operational routine to top-tier strategic governance, aimed at mitigating technical decoupling risks from sudden policy shifts. It serves as both a proactive institutional alignment with US export controls and a mechanism to secure regulatory credibility by institutionalizing oversight in response to intensifying geopolitical scrutiny.

headlines.title_zh: Numa完成4500万美元C轮融资，估值达5亿美元
headlines.title_en: Oakland-based Numa, which builds an AI platform to manage car dealership customer service, raised a $45M Series C, a source says at a $500M post-money valuation (Camila Grigera Naón/Fortune)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 奥克兰AI平台公司Numa完成4500万美元C轮融资，旨在通过AI智能体优化汽车经销商客户服务与业务流程
headlines.event_summary_en: Oakland-based AI startup Numa raised $45 million in a Series C round led by Blue Cloud Ventures, reaching a $500 million post-money valuation. The company develops an AI operating system that integrates with dealership software to automate appointment scheduling, inventory management, and warranty paperwork to address inefficiencies in automotive retail.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Numa（首席执行官 Tasso Roumeliotis），Blue Cloud Ventures（领投方）在汽车零售数字化转型领域：完成4500万美元C轮融资，投后估值5亿美元
【起因与机理】利用AI智能体解决汽车经销商高频、低效的人工客服与行政流程
【关键数据与实测】Numa完成4500万美元C轮融资，投后估值升至5亿美元。
【各方立场与态度】Blue Cloud Ventures领投，累计融资额达9600万美元，旨在扩大AI智能体在垂直行业的渗透。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Numa (CEO Tasso Roumeliotis), Blue Cloud Ventures (Lead Investor): $45 million Series C funding, $500M post-money valuation
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Automating high-frequency, manual customer service and administrative tasks for car dealerships using AI agents
[Key Metrics] Numa secures $45M Series C, reaching $500M valuation.
[Key Position & Outlook] Led by Blue Cloud Ventures, total funding reaches $96M to drive industry-specific AI agent adoption.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: Numa的商业模型标志着AI智能体从通用助理向特定行业深层工作流（Workflow-Specific）的垂直演进。通过获取经销商底层的库存与销售数据，该平台在实现业务流程闭环的同时，建立了极高的行业壁垒，使其不仅是自动化工具，更成为汽车后市场的数据枢纽。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Numa’s model signals a shift from general-purpose assistants to workflow-specific AI agents within vertical industries. By integrating with underlying dealer inventory and transaction systems, Numa creates high switching costs and establishes itself as a data hub in the automotive aftermarket, moving beyond simple automation tools.

headlines.title_zh: Meta调整Instagram印度推荐算法以过滤违规内容
headlines.title_en: Meta says it modified Instagram's recommendation systems in India to show less sexual and violent content, after New Delhi called for tighter content checks (Reuters)
headlines.event_summary_zh: Meta为响应印度电子信息技术部对推荐算法的监管要求，针对印度市场升级AI模型，重点过滤Instagram内包含暴力与软色情内容的推荐推送
headlines.event_summary_en: Meta Platforms has fine-tuned Instagram's recommendation algorithms for the Indian market by deploying advanced AI models to proactively detect and restrict violent and sexually suggestive content across Reels, Explore, and Feed. This adjustment follows a regulatory advisory from the Indian Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology regarding the scrutiny of algorithmic ranking and content amplification.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Meta Platforms；印度电子信息技术部 (Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology)在印度数字内容分发平台（Instagram）：通过算法升级主动过滤软色情与暴力内容，并优化Reels与推荐机制
【起因与机理】应对印度政府对算法放大误导性及敏感内容的安全监管合规要求
【关键技术规格】核心诉求：响应印度电子信息技术部关于审查算法放大误导性内容的行政指导。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：平台通过调整推荐逻辑降低了用户违规内容举报率，但未披露具体过滤比例或技术参数。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Meta Platforms; Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology of India (Instagram ecosystem in India): Upgraded AI models to proactively filter suggestive and violent content in recommendations
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Regulatory pressure to mitigate algorithmic amplification of sensitive or misleading materials
[Key Fact Detail] Core demand: Responding to the advisory from the Indian Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology regarding algorithmic transparency.
[Key Position & Outlook] Outlook: Reported a reduction in user-reported content, though technical metrics and specific filtering thresholds remain undisclosed.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: Meta在印度采取的算法合规动作，反映了跨国互联网巨头在大型新兴市场正面临从“事后删除”向“事前算法风控”的技术路线强制转型。这种以局部市场适配为代价的合规策略，预示着全球社交平台需为各主权国家定制特定的AI安全对齐标准，以规避针对算法推荐逻辑的贸易与监管壁垒。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Meta's compliance adjustment in India reflects a forced shift for global platforms from reactive content removal to proactive algorithmic risk management in key emerging markets. This regional-specific alignment strategy suggests that major social platforms will increasingly need to engineer sovereignty-compliant AI safety guardrails to mitigate regulatory barriers targeting their recommendation logic.

titans.quote_zh:
RT @halcyonrayes：我要求 claude 在 cuda c++ 中完全实现 trellis.2，它比原始 pytorch 实现快 5.3 倍 🚀

令人惊讶的是，glb-export 函数是瓶颈，而不是神经网络本身。将导出转移到 GPU 带来的收益比其他任何东西都多。

- 零 Python 运行时，全部用 C++ 实现 ⚡️
- 费用💵？克劳德约 7 美元，计算约 60 美元，用于通过 @huggingface 作业在 h200 上进行测试
- 它仍然提供了 2.2 倍更好的性能，同时按位相同🎯

该代码是开源的，可以在这里使用——

将其用作代理优化模型的来源，或直接使用它。黑客快乐！ 🤗
titans.quote_en:
RT @halcyonrayes: i asked claude to implement trellis.2 fully in cuda c++, and it is 5.3x faster than the original pytorch implementation 🚀 

surprisingly, the glb-export function was the bottleneck, not the neural net itself. moving exporting to the gpu gave more gains than anything else.

- zero python runtime, all in c++ ⚡️
- cost 💵 ? ~$7 on claude and ~$60 on compute for testing on h200s through @huggingface jobs 
- it still gave 2.2x better perf while being bitwise identical 🎯

the code is open-sourced for use here -- https://t.co/YDxMFveRnC

use it as a source for your agent to optimize your models, or utilize it directly. happy hacking! 🤗

tool_item.pain_point_zh: 编码代理自主生成代码时常不自觉引入反序列化、注入或权限绕过漏洞，传统人工审计耗时且容易遗漏隐蔽攻击面。

key_features_en: Multi-Phase Independent Verification: Executes threat modeling, taint analysis, and boundary audits on diffs
Machine-Readable Audit Evals: Formats findings so coding agents can self-heal vulnerabilities automatically
Zero Cloud Data Leakage: Runs locally sandboxed rule matching to guarantee proprietary code privacy
